name: fz556_stance_change_soak
purpose: Samurott Soaks Aegislash (step 2); Stance Change to the Blade forme (step 4) runs setSpecies, which resets the types to Steel/Ghost (sim/pokemon.ts:1392), so Meowscarada's Low Sweep into its Substitute is -immune (step 9). On main the engine kept the Water type, hit the Substitute and stopped with E_INVARIANT at step 9 (issue 556). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_377_77), whole. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
